name: FIWM Double Mags
teaser:
Makes all mags double the ammo capacity and u can more.
Also u can boost load\unload speed of ammo.
description_html:
This mod can increase the capacity of ammo in any mags by 2 or whatever how u want.

Also u can boost load\unload speed of ammo. (Default OFF)*

Inspired by an old mod I used a long time ago. Unfortunately, I couldn’t find the author or the mod on this site.

* I made it disabled by default because many use SVM and other mods for change ammo speed, if you need it - turn ON.

Don’t forget that speed of load\unload increases as you upgrade your skills, so I recommend not to use values higher than -80
